title: ForecastCompass: Guiding Agentic Forecasting with Adaptive Factor Memory

claim.summary: ForecastCompass stores predictive factors and calibration lessons by event category, then updates them by comparing prior forecasts with outcome-revealed retrospective analyses.

modules.name: Adaptive predictive-factor and calibration memory
modules.scope_reason: Memory is optimized for probabilistic future-event forecasting and corrected only after resolution.
